headline: Platform Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure & Automation
summary: Platform Engineer with over 6 years of experience building scalable cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices architectures. Passionate about automating operational tasks, improving developer productivity, and maintaining high-availability systems. Proven track record in cloud migration and site reliability engineering within the Nepali technology ecosystem.

experiences.title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Lead the platform team in migrating legacy monolithic applications to Kubernetes-based microservices, reducing deployment time by 40%.
Architected multi-region AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Ansible to ensure 99.99% service uptime.
Implemented comprehensive monitoring and alerting solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack.
Mentored junior engineers on best practices for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud security.

experiences.title: DevOps Engineer
description: Managed end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for high-traffic healthcare data processing platforms.
Automated server provisioning and configuration management using Chef, reducing manual intervention by 60%.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to resolve production bottlenecks and optimize database performance.
Assisted in the implementation of disaster recovery protocols for critical financial data.

experiences.title: Junior System Engineer
description: Provided operational support for internal development environments and production servers.
Maintained Linux-based server infrastructure and handled routine security patches.
Authored internal documentation for deployment procedures and system troubleshooting.
